subject.title: Workspaces: add version history and exact restore

question: Should plugin-sdk/plugin-state-runtime publicly expose getNodeSqliteKysely, executeSqliteQuerySync, and executeSqliteQueryTakeFirstSync as the supported way for plugins to run typed synchronous queries against plugin-owned SQLite databases?
rationale: The Workspaces plugin cannot import core internals, but exporting generic query execution creates a durable third-party API contract; code correctness alone cannot choose that long-term SDK boundary.

options.title: Approve the focused exports
options.body: Keep the three generic helpers on the narrow plugin-state runtime subpath and support them as the typed synchronous SQLite seam for plugins.

options.title: Introduce a narrower facade
options.body: Replace generic query execution with a smaller owner-approved plugin database abstraction before merging this feature.

options.title: Defer history restore
options.body: Pause this PR until a broader plugin-owned SQLite API direction is designed elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Approve the focused exports
recommendation.body: Keep the three generic helpers on the narrow plugin-state runtime subpath and support them as the typed synchronous SQLite seam for plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the merged Workspaces implementation and authored the internal synchronous Kysely helper contract being promoted.
